description: This file is a PHP web page for configuring initial gateway setup, including LAN IP, subnet mask, DHCP settings, and DMZ host configuration. It includes embedded PHP for dynamic values, JavaScript for client-side validation and interaction, and HTML for the structure.

methods.name: setIPconfiguration
methods.description: Sends AJAX request to update network configuration with current form data, prompting for confirmation if DHCP/IP settings change.

methods.name: calcuate_lease_time
methods.description: Converts lease time value and unit into seconds or -1 for forever.

methods.name: display_time_format
methods.description: Displays lease time in appropriate units based on total seconds.

methods.name: checkForRebooting
methods.description: Polls the device to determine when it has rebooted after configuration changes.

methods.name: edmz
methods.description: Enables or disables DMZ IP input fields based on checkbox.
